posts.author: Hans
posts.content_md: Use a very large syringe to store the developer. I have a 60ml one. When you are ready to use the developer, dump the developer in the tray. After development, suck the liquid back into the syringe. If you need more developer for large trays, use two syringes.

posts.author: glajciorz
posts.content_md:
Or use a mineral water plastic bottle and squeeze it after filling with developer.

I still use 0,5l of JD4 prepared 3 months ago kept in a 0,5l bottle. I only need to squeeze out 20-30ml of air out of the bottle after each use.

I've also found nice 1l brown-colored transparent plastic bottles which were with bread acid before.

greetings

Adam
